in_sanskrit.name: Jashmitha
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Born from the goddess Yashaswini
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Jashmitha एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Jashmitha is a name derived from the Sanskrit word Yashaswini, which means 'Born from the goddess Yashaswini'. In Hindu mythology, Yashaswini is a goddess of fertility and prosperity. Jashmitha is believed to bring good fortune, prosperity, and fertility to those who bear this name.
